//Enable transparent huge pages on Linux: OFF, ON, FULL, DEFAULT.
// 'FULL' enables THP and also avoids splitting up huge pages during
// purging.
MI_ALLOW_THP:STRING=DEFAULT

//Deprecated: Use full internal invariant checking in DEBUG mode
// (use MI_DEBUG=FULL instead)
MI_CHECK_FULL:BOOL=OFF

//Enable assertion checks: OFF, ON, INTERNAL, FULL, DEFAULT. INTERNAL
// adds extra internal invariant checks, while FULL adds expensive
// heap invariant checks
MI_DEBUG:STRING=DEFAULT

//Deprecated: Enable assertion checks and expensive internal heap
// invariant checking (use MI_DEBUG=FULL instead)
MI_DEBUG_FULL:BOOL=OFF

//Deprecated: Enable assertion and internal invariant checks (use
// MI_DEBUG=INTERNAL instead)
MI_DEBUG_INTERNAL:BOOL=OFF

//Build with thread sanitizer (needs clang)
MI_DEBUG_TSAN:BOOL=OFF

//Build with undefined-behavior sanitizer (needs clang++)
MI_DEBUG_UBSAN:BOOL=OFF

//Extra pre-processor definitions (use as `-DMI_EXTRA_CPPDEFS="opt1=val1;opt2=val2"`)
MI_EXTRA_CPPDEFS:BOOL=OFF

//Check for invalid pointers in 'mi_free': OFF, SHARED, ON, DEFAULT.
// 'SHARED' enables it only for the dynamic/shared library when
// MI_OVERRIDE is ON
MI_FREE_IS_CHECKED:STRING=DEFAULT

//Always use the page map when free-ing a pointer -- enable only
// for systems that don't support large OS aligned allocations
// well.
MI_FREE_USE_PAGEMAP:BOOL=OFF

//Build with guard pages behind certain object allocations (enabled
// by default in a debug build)
MI_GUARDED:BOOL=OFF

//Install directly into $CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX instead of PREFIX/lib/mimalloc-version
MI_INSTALL_TOPLEVEL:BOOL=OFF

//Enable this when linking with musl libc
MI_LIBC_MUSL:BOOL=OFF

//Deprecated: Use local-dynamic-tls, a slightly slower but dlopen-compatible
// thread local storage mechanism (Unix) (use MI_TLS_MODEL=LOCAL_DYNAMIC
// instead)
MI_LOCAL_DYNAMIC_TLS:BOOL=OFF

//Disable all assertion checks even in debug builds
MI_NO_DEBUG:BOOL=OFF

//Force no use of padding even in DEBUG mode etc.
MI_NO_PADDING:BOOL=OFF

//Disable transparent huge pages support on Linux/Android for the
// mimalloc process only
MI_NO_THP:BOOL=OFF

//Only for optimized builds: turn on architecture specific optimizations
// (for x64: '-march=haswell;-mavx2' (2013), for arm64: '-march=armv8.1-a'
// (2016), for riscV: '-march=rv64gcb_zacas' (2023))
MI_OPT_ARCH:STRING=DEFAULT

//Deprecated: Use aligned `mi_free_small` without pagemap lookup
// (can only be used if SECURE or GUARDED mode are off)
MI_OPT_FREE_SMALL:BOOL=OFF

//Use SIMD instructions (requires MI_OPT_ARCH to be enabled)
MI_OPT_SIMD:BOOL=OFF

//Enable padding to detect heap block overflow (always on in DEBUG
// or SECURE mode, or with Valgrind/ASAN)
MI_PADDING:BOOL=OFF

//Use security mitigations (like meta data guard pages, allocation
// randomization, double-free mitigation, and free-list corruption
// detection): OFF, ON, FULL. The FULL setting adds guard pages
// at the end of each mimalloc page (which may be expensive)
MI_SECURE:STRING=OFF

//Deprecated: Use full security mitigations including guard pages
// at the end of each mimalloc page (may be expensive) (use MI_SECURE=FULL
// instead)
MI_SECURE_FULL:BOOL=OFF

//Generate assembly files
MI_SEE_ASM:BOOL=OFF

//Show error and warning messages by default (only enabled by default
// in DEBUG mode)
MI_SHOW_ERRORS:BOOL=OFF

//Skip collecting memory on program exit
MI_SKIP_COLLECT_ON_EXIT:BOOL=OFF

//Force TLS model: LOCAL (thread local variables), PTHREADS (pthread
// locals), LOCAL_DYNAMIC (dlopen-compatible thread local storage
// mechanism (Unix)), WIN32 (direct Windows TLS slots), FIXED (fixed
// thread local slots), DEFAULT.
MI_TLS_MODEL:STRING=DEFAULT

//Deprecated: Force TLS model based on fixed thread local slots
// (use MI_TLS_MODEL=FIXED instead)
MI_TLS_MODEL_FIXED:BOOL=OFF

//Deprecated: Force TLS model based on thread local variables (use
// MI_TLS_MODEL=LOCAL instead)
MI_TLS_MODEL_LOCAL:BOOL=OFF

//Deprecated: Force TLS model based on pthreads (use MI_TLS_MODEL=PTHREADS
// instead)
MI_TLS_MODEL_PTHREADS:BOOL=OFF

//Force a recursion check on thread local access (for MI_TLS_MODEL_LOCAL
// only)
MI_TLS_RECURSE_GUARD:BOOL=OFF

//Enable tracking: OFF, ASAN (address sanitizer), VALGRIND, ETW
// (Windows event tracing). Adds a small overhead.
MI_TRACK:STRING=OFF

//Deprecated: Compile with address sanitizer support (adds a small
// overhead) (use MI_TRACK=ASAN instead)
MI_TRACK_ASAN:BOOL=OFF

//Deprecated: Compile with Windows event tracing (ETW) support
// (adds a small overhead) (use MI_TRACK=ETW instead)
MI_TRACK_ETW:BOOL=OFF

//Deprecated: Compile with Valgrind support (adds a small overhead)
// (use MI_TRACK=VALGRIND instead)
MI_TRACK_VALGRIND:BOOL=OFF

//Use the C++ compiler to compile the library (instead of the C
// compiler)
MI_USE_CXX:STRING=DEFAULT

//Deprecated: Explicitly link with -latomic (on older systems)
// (deprecated and detected automatically)
MI_USE_LIBATOMIC:BOOL=OFF

//Deprecated: Use only direct TLS slots on Windows to avoid extra
// tests in the malloc fast path (only works if the program uses
// less than 64 TlsAlloc'd slots in total)
MI_WIN_DIRECT_TLS:BOOL=OFF

//Force Windows intialization strategy: CRT_TLS (default), RAW_DLLMAIN
// (use raw DLL main entry point), TLS_DLLMAIN (TLS entries with
// DllMain), FLS (legacy fiber API), DEFAULT
MI_WIN_INIT:STRING=DEFAULT

//Deprecated: Use the raw DLL main entry point for mimalloc initialization;
// can be more robust but can also lead to link errors with other
// libraries (use MI_WIN_INIT=RAW_DLLMAIN instead)
MI_WIN_INIT_USE_RAW_DLLMAIN:BOOL=OFF

//Deprecated: Use legacy TLS entries with DllMain for mimalloc
// initialization (use MI_WIN_INIT=TLS_DLLMAIN instead)
MI_WIN_INIT_USE_TLS_DLLMAIN:BOOL=OFF

//Deprecated: Use Fiber local storage on Windows to detect thread
// termination (use MI_WIN_INIT=FLS instead)
MI_WIN_USE_FLS:BOOL=OFF

//Enable abort() call on memory allocation failure by default
MI_XMALLOC:BOOL=OFF

//Native loop alignment: AUTO, ON, or OFF
STANLI_ALIGN_LOOPS:STRING=AUTO

//Build a non-installed allocator measurement DSO

//Drop the propto instantiation family: half the size, lp__ off
